title: corynephorus divaricatus
intro: Corynephorus divaricatus, commonly known as sideoats grama, is a type of perennial grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Corynephorus divaricatus include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Corynephorus divaricatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
